policy: inactive-input kernel (COMMON-AD 87.1): reads no device memory; out (declination, solar constant) depends only on by-value host calendar scalars; out derivative words zero both ways

args.name: julian
args.inactive_reason: By-value host calendar scalar (curr_julday, fractional day of year); not window state.

args.name: out
args.inactive_reason: Declination and solar constant: functions of the inactive scalars only, read back to the host (driver_controls words.get()). Overwritten, so the derivative words are zeroed (not identity).

branches.inactive_reason: Day-of-year origin on an inactive scalar (spring equinox); the two arms meet at julian=80 up to f32 rounding of 365*dpd*degrad vs 2*pi.

refusal.domain: julian, degrad, dpd and the forward's f32 sinf/cosf arguments (23.5*degrad, sx, rjul, 2*rjul) finite; then both outputs are finite

precondition: out and its derivative mirror are the forward's view (2 words); no other memory is read or written.
precision: no float derivative arithmetic; the refusal check recomputes the forward's f32 sinf/cosf arguments with its own __fmul_rn/__fadd_rn/__fsub_rn/__fdiv_rn order. Built -O3 --fmad=false --ftz=false (live-scheme flags) for uniformity.
piecewise_affine_arms: Constant (zero) map on out for every executed branch: the kernel has no active input.
